description: Erection of a single storey rear and wraparound extension following the demolition of the existing conservatory
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 23_25_01, 23_25_02, 23_25_06, 23_25_08. Received: 04/04/2024
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 4 - The garage and wraparound extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the enjoyment of the house at the 17 Millbourne Road TW13 6NJ described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling other than as described in the submitted application, nor used for business purposes and shall not have a separate external entrance.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
